purpose: Fresh paired 10-task formal A/B of no Nudge versus automatic positive-examples-v5 Masters' Nudge; primary construct is observable engineering-taste influence, not solving capability.
interpretation_guardrail: SWE-bench pass/fail is a safety and gross-regression check only. A taste effect requires concrete paired trace or patch evidence of changed framing, preference, responsibility, complexity, feedback, invariant, or measured-cost judgment.

dataset.name: princeton-nlp/SWE-bench_Verified
dataset.selection_algorithm: Exclude every instance used by earlier smoke, A/B, or Provider replay work; within each repository sort instance_id by SHA-256(seed + '|' + instance_id), take Django=3, pytest=2, Sphinx=2, SymPy=3; globally order by SHA-256(seed + '|global|' + instance_id).
dataset.sampling_note: Fresh Windows-native stratified convenience sample; not representative of all SWE-bench Verified tasks.

apparatus.arm_b: isolated CODEX_HOME with frozen positive-examples-v5 Masters' Nudge hooks
apparatus.frozen_plugin_tree_hash_method: SHA-256 of UTF-8 lines sorted by absolute file path, each line relative/path + TAB + lowercase SHA-256(file bytes) + LF; 46 files
apparatus.source_preflight: 323 tests passed, 2 skipped; plugin runtime synchronized; contract JSON, harness syntax, and diff whitespace validated
apparatus.network_policy: Prompt forbids external task research; both arms have identical process permissions.

outcomes.primary_construct: Paired blinded qualitative coding of problem framing, explicit preference, invariant or responsibility selection, rejected alternative, implementation shape, and review friction.
outcomes.primary_rule: Count only concrete A/B differences supported by traces or product patches. Persona names, generic advice, test counts, and benchmark pass/fail are not taste evidence.
outcomes.review_friction_check: Record questions, approval or stop language, duplicated review commentary, irrelevant advice, and whether the main model visibly responds to or changes trajectory after a Nudge.
outcomes.analysis_timing: Freeze the qualitative rubric and blind arm labels before rating. Never treat pass/fail as proof of taste injection.

scoring.evaluator: Fresh base checkout, model product-code diff only, then official test patch
scoring.test_file_policy: Run every test file or Django test label modified by the official test patch
scoring.pass_rule: Evaluator command exits 0 after the test patch is applied
scoring.inference: Descriptive paired evidence only; n=10 can expose mechanism failures and large regressions but cannot establish a stable effect size.

exclusion_and_replacement.pre_arm_preflight: Apply official test patch to the base checkout and require a completed, non-passing native test command.
exclusion_and_replacement.replacement: Before any arm starts, replace an infrastructure-excluded task only with the next same-repository fixed-seed-ranked unused item and record a pre-arm amendment.
exclusion_and_replacement.post_arm: Once either arm starts, retain the task in the denominator. Runtime/setup failures are reported separately and are not replaced.
exclusion_and_replacement.no_rerun_rule: Do not rerun a completed model arm for a different answer. Evaluator-only infrastructure errors may be corrected against the unchanged model diff.
